title: could we all be having similar dreams because we’re on similar medications?

classification.theory_summary: Asks whether shared Mall World-style dreams could be related to psychotropic medications (mentions SSRIs; notes intense dreams/nightmares as side effects; asks users what meds they take).
classification.question_topic: Whether similar/shared dream spaces could be caused by medications; requests respondents' medication lists.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream narrative or location descriptions; post is research/survey question about medication correlation.

meta.author_theory: Possible shared cause: psychotropic medication (e.g., SSRIs). Notes side effects: intense dreams/nightmares; for SSRIs specifically, reduced dream recall. Author reports being on sertraline 100mg and adderall 20mg.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no phenomenological dream content (no described environments, sensations, entities, or events). It is a medication-correlation survey/research prompt.
